$comment: Typed sub-schemas for the agent-facing result contracts. The Rust types in app/core/src/receipt.rs, cut-core::diff, and the comment draft are the source of truth; this file mirrors their serialized shape so an agent and the autopilot can reason over a typed contract instead of prose. A round-trip test in app/core/tests/receipt_schema.rs asserts the Rust types serialize with these required keys, and verbs.json result_schema entries point here.

FixTarget.description: Where a defect lives, lifted from a check's evidence. All optional — a check carries whichever coordinates it measured; never fabricated.

clip_id.description: Clip to target the repair edit.

op_id.description: Op that introduced the defect, when traceable.

FixAction.description: A machine-actionable repair derived from one FAILING check — the contract that the Receipted-Autopilot self-fix loop maps a receipt onto.

check.description: The failing check name this addresses.

fix_verb.description: Verb to call to repair it; '(manual)' when no mechanical fix exists.

fix_args.description: Best-effort partial args for fix_verb; the autopilot merges in render/target context.

measured.description: The measured numbers + target that justify the fix.

rationale.description: One-line why, for the plan + user-facing 'what changed'.

auto_fixable.description: true = mechanical + safe for the self-fix loop; false = needs a human or verify.judge.

CheckResult.description: Result of one verify check. evidence always carries the numbers that justify the verdict (never a bare boolean).

name.description: cut_on_word | lufs | caption_presence | black_or_frozen_frames | silence_at_edges | duration_matches_edl | uniform_border | cut_on_beat | j_l_cut | footage_profile

evidence.description: The measured facts behind the verdict (timestamps, LUFS, spans, violations).

RenderReceipt.description: The receipt for a completed render. Persisted at receipts/<render_id>.json, pushed over WS as receipt_ready. 'done requires evidence'.

output_hash.description: Content hash — same input+EDL ⇒ same hash (determinism).

at_op.description: Op id of the log head when the render started — ties the receipt to an exact timeline state.

pass.description: Aggregate: true iff every check passed.

judge.description: Optional perceptual judge (verify.judge) attachment; never a fake pass.

fix_actions.description: One entry per recognised FAILING check — the autopilot self-fix substrate. Empty when every check passed.

OutputCheckRerunHandle.description: Immediate handle returned by verify.rerun. Poll jobs.status for the separate OutputCheckRerun receipt.

output_hash.description: The source RenderReceipt hash verified before the job was allocated.

OutputCheckRerun.description: Independent persisted output-only recheck receipt. It links to, and never replaces, the RenderReceipt produced by render.final.

source_receipt_id.description: The immutable RenderReceipt.render_id whose output was checked.

verification_receipt.description: Server-generated project-relative path of this separate receipt.

DiffSummary.description: Result of project.diff — the structural delta between two op-log pointers.

ops.description: Number of ops between the two pointers.

CommentDraft.description: Result of comment.draft — the agent's proposed verb changes for a timecoded review note (not yet applied).
